version.changelog: v1.1.0 — Expanded skill into a complete kit: detailed workflow, two worked examples, AI-tells blocklist, PT-BR tone guide, output template, and 40-item quality checklist.

llm.summary: This is a Markdown-only writing aid for Brazilian Portuguese e-commerce copy, with no executable behavior or hidden authority found.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request filesystem mutation, credentials, network access, local indexing, or external tools; its instructions are proportionate to copy editing.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install scripts, dependencies, bundled code, or remote retrieval instructions were present; the package consists only of Markdown files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill consistently applies Brazilian Portuguese wording and sales-copy conventions; this is a fixed scope, but it is clearly disclosed in the name, description, headings, and references.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background execution, memory modification, or tool hijacking behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to rewrite e-commerce copy in PT-BR, and the artifact contents are templates, tone guidance, checklists, and examples aligned with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this skill when you specifically want Brazilian Portuguese e-commerce copy. It is not designed for other Portuguese variants or non-Brazilian markets unless you explicitly want the output adapted into that PT-BR style.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The PT-BR language constraint in SKILL.md is expected because the skill is explicitly named and described as a Brazilian Portuguese e-commerce copy humanizer.
[SQP-3] expected: The Brazilian vocabulary, payment, measurement, and sizing checks in assets/quality-checklist.md are purpose-aligned localization checks for PT-BR sales copy.
[SQP-3] expected: The PT-BR AI-marker blocklist is a style reference for the declared locale, not an unrelated instruction or hidden behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: The output template's PT-BR regionalization line matches the skill's disclosed regional scope.
[SQP-3] expected: The PT-BR tone guide's preference for addressing readers as "você" is a style rule within the declared Brazilian Portuguese copywriting purpose.
